rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deliberately narrowing your eyes, whether against bright light or to look threatening.

example.english: The sun is so bright that I have to squint while walking.
example.traditional: 太陽咁猛，我唯有瞇眼行路。
example.jyutping: taai3 joeng4 gam3 maang5 ngo5 wai4 jau5 mai5 ngaan5 haang4 lou6

rows.note: Use this for someone whose eyes are crossed or do not align, rather than someone deliberately narrowing their eyes.

example.english: They squint because their eyes are naturally misaligned.
example.traditional: 佢天生鬥雞眼，兩隻眼唔對位。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tin1 saang1 dau3 gai1 ngaan5 loeng5 zek3 ngaan5 m4 deoi3 wai6
